items.name: LBW Love Beyond Wicket
items.overview: A washed-up PT teacher, a legendary coach and a generation of misfit students come together to save a legacy.

items.name: Alien Earth
items.overview: When the mysterious deep space research vessel USCSS Maginot crash-lands on Earth, Wendy and a ragtag group of tactical soldiers make a fateful discovery that puts them face-to-face with the planet's greatest threat.

items.name: Paap Kahini
items.overview: A simple village wife, who is the victim of her husband’s betrayal, takes terrible revenge on him. But what is that revenge?

items.name: The Traitors
items.overview: A group of contestants arrive with hopes of winning a large cash prize of ₹1 crore that is built up through missions. The players are referred to as the "Innocents", but among them are the "Traitors" — a group of contestants secretly selected by the host. If the Innocents eliminate all the Traitors, they will share the prize fund. However, if any Traitors manage to make it to the end, eliminating the Innocents, they win the entire prize money.

items.name: Queen of Tears
items.overview: The queen of department stores and the prince of supermarkets weather a marital crisis—until love miraculously begins to bloom again.

items.name: Amidst A Snowstorm Of Love
items.overview: As a professional billiards player, Yin Guo has become quite a notable athlete. After receiving an invitation to play in a tournament in Hel, Yin Guo eagerly accepts. Little does she know that meeting former professional billiards player, Lin Yiyang, in Hel will change her life forever.

items.name: Astey Ladies
items.overview: Three desperate women turn robbers to save their hairstyling parlour, Salon De Paris. Now, they're in the middle of something big: a diamond heist! What's next?

items.name: Bachelor Point
items.overview: Four young men from different districts of Bangladesh encounter various challenges as they try to live an independent life in the city, Dhaka.

items.name: Ben 10 Alien Force
items.overview: 15-year-old Ben Tennyson chooses to once again put on the Omnitrix and discovers that it has recalibrated and can now transform him into 10 brand-new aliens. Joined by his super-powered cousin Gwen Tennyson and his equally powerful former enemy Kevin Levin, Ben is on a mission to find his missing Grandpa Max.

items.name: Berlin and the Lady with an Ermine
items.overview: Hungry for a new heist, Berlin summons the gang to Seville and turns an ambitious duke into the victim of his own plan: to steal a da Vinci masterpiece.

cast.name: José Luis García Pérez
cast.character: Álvaro Hermoso de Medina, Duke of Málaga

items.name: Bigg Boss OTT
items.overview: Sass aur Sazish, Drama aur Romance... itna over the top ke TV pe ban ho jayega! Karan Johar flags off the first-ever, the digital-only season of Bigg Boss with the bigg promise of gossip, controversies & uncensored drama. And let's just say... he's going to take it ALL #OverTheTop!

items.name: Dadagiri Unlimited
items.overview: Dadagiri Unlimited is a  Bengali reality quiz show where contestants from different West Bengal districts compete in trivia rounds. Originally hosted by former Indian cricket captain Sourav Ganguly (Dada),currently hosted by tollywood actor Dev , the show blends competitive general knowledge with inspiring real-life stories of everyday heroes.

items.name: Dexter Original Sin
items.overview: In 1991 Miami, Dexter Morgan transitions from student to avenging serial killer. When his bloodthirsty urges can't be ignored any longer, Dexter must learn to channel his inner darkness. With the guidance of his father, Harry, he adopts a Code designed to help him find and kill people who deserve to be eliminated from society without getting on law enforcements' radar. This is a particular challenge for young Dexter as he begins a forensics internship at the Miami Metro Police Department.

items.name: Family Feud
items.overview: Two families compete against each other in a contest to name the most popular responses to a survey question posed to 100 people.

items.name: From
items.overview: Unravel the mystery of a nightmarish town in middle America that traps all those who enter. As the unwilling residents fight to keep a sense of normalcy and search for a way out, they must also survive the threats of the surrounding forest – including the terrifying creatures that come out when the sun goes down.

items.name: Heart Beat
items.overview: RK Multispeciality Hospital is a beacon of hope and healing. Its doctors are resilient even when they have to deal with medical and personal challenges.

items.name: Indian Game Show
items.overview: The Indian Game Show is a high-energy comedy game show created and hosted by Bharti Singh and Haarsh Limbachiyaa. Featuring popular television actors, choreographers, musicians, and social media influencers, contestants face off in physical stunts, comedy challenges, and quirky tasks to win prizes while avoiding hilarious punishments

items.name: Its Okay to Not Be Okay
Love Next Door
items.overview: A woman attempting to reboot her life returns to Korea and becomes entangled with her childhood friend — with whom she shares a complicated history.

items.name: MTV Hustle
items.overview: MTV Hustle is India's first rap reality show. Judged by Raftaar, Nucleya and Raja Kumari, it premiered on 9 August 2019. Hosted by Gaelyn Mendonca, it airs on MTV India.

items.name: My Bias My Boss
items.overview: A dedicated fangirl lands a job at a fashion company, only to discover it was co-founded by her ultimate idol. Determined to remain professional, she hides her identity, but is quickly thrown off course by the company's workaholic CEO. As secret unrequited feelings and hidden personal struggles entangle the trio, she finds herself torn between her lifelong obsession and an unexpected new connection.

items.name: Naagin
items.overview: A miraculous shape-shifting snake has the power to become a human. She can be anybody she wants: a wife, a seductress, a mistress, a damsel in distress: all in the name of revenge.

items.name: Narcos
items.overview: A gritty chronicle of the war against Colombia's infamously violent and powerful drug cartels.

items.name: Naruto Shippuden
items.overview: After 2 and a half years Naruto finally returns to his village of Konoha, and sets about putting his ambitions to work. It will not be easy though as he has amassed a few more dangerous enemies, in the likes of the shinobi organization; Akatsuki.

items.name: One Piece
items.overview: With his straw hat and ragtag crew, young pirate Monkey D. Luffy goes on an epic voyage for treasure.

items.name: Peaky Blinders
items.overview: A gangster family epic set in 1919 Birmingham, England and centered on a gang who sew razor blades in the peaks of their caps, and their fierce boss Tommy Shelby, who means to move up in the world.

items.name: Rise And Fall
items.overview: The story revolves around the host explaining the show where 4 celebrities, of which 2 in the penthouse, are trying to maintain their position as Rulers while 2 in the basement are fighting to Rise to the Penthouse to topple a Ruler.

items.name: See You at Work Tomorrow
items.overview: Cha Ji-yoon is a 7th-year corporate worker who's tired of both work and dating. She crosses paths with Kang Si-woo, the cynical boss with a terrifying reputation. Unexpectedly, she regains spark in her life as she gets to know the kindness behind his stern words. Amid repeated commutes, accidents at work, and failed relationships, the two become each other's irreplaceable anchor.

items.name: Spooky in Love
items.overview: When a ghost-seeing heir and an ace prosecutor learn that a single touch makes them a strangely effective duo, they team up to crack unsolved murders.

items.name: Taqdeer
items.overview: Freezer van driver Taqdeer spirals into a dark game of destiny after he finds the unclaimed dead body of a woman in his truck.

items.name: Taxi Driver
items.overview: A former special forces soldier delivers revenge for victims of injustice while working for a secret organization that fronts as a taxi company.

items.name: The Agency
items.overview: Covert CIA agent Martian is ordered to abandon his undercover life and return to London Station. When the love he left behind unexpectedly reappears, their romance reignites, pitting his career, his real identity and his mission against his heart while hurling them both into a deadly game of international intrigue and espionage.

items.name: The Apartment Job
items.overview: Desperate for cash, a former gang boss teams up with an aspiring lawyer to steal an apartment complex's reserve fund — only to uncover deep corruption.

items.name: The Big Bang Theory
items.overview: Physicists Leonard and Sheldon find their nerd-centric social circle with pals Howard and Raj expanding when aspiring actress Penny moves in next door.

items.name: The Family Man
items.overview: A widowed fire chief tries to raise his four children with help from his father-in-law.

items.name: The Good Doctor
items.overview: Shaun Murphy, a young surgeon with autism and savant syndrome, relocates from a quiet country life to join a prestigious hospital's surgical unit. Unable to personally connect with those around him, Shaun uses his extraordinary medical gifts to save lives and challenge the skepticism of his colleagues.

items.name: The Great Indian Kapil Show
items.overview: Comedian Kapil Sharma hosts this laugh-out-loud variety talk show with celebrity guests, hilarious antics and his signature supporting cast.

items.name: The Summer I Turned Pretty
items.overview: Every summer, Belly and her family head to the Fishers’ beach house in Cousins. Every summer is the same ... until Belly turns sixteen. Relationships will be tested, painful truths will be revealed, and Belly will be forever changed. It’s a summer of first love, first heartbreak and growing up — it's the summer she turns pretty.

items.name: The Worst Of Evil
items.overview: Set in the 1980s, a husband and wife, both detectives, infiltrate a massive criminal organization responsible for the illegal drug trade between Korea, China, and Japan.

items.name: Vikram On Duty
items.overview: Battling his past and personal demons, a disgraced but brilliant supercop will stop at nothing to solve crimes and earn back the uniform that defined him.

items.name: Yellowjackets
items.overview: This equal parts survival epic, psychological horror story and coming-of-age drama tells the saga of a team of wildly talented high school girls soccer players who become the (un)lucky survivors of a plane crash deep in the remote northern wilderness. The series chronicles their descent from a complicated but thriving team to savage clans, while also tracking the lives they’ve attempted to piece back together nearly 25 years later.

items.name: Yumi s Cells
items.overview: Yumi is a 30-year old, ordinary woman who struggles with expressing her feelings. Told from the perspective of the many brain cells in her head, she experiences growth in both her love life, her career, and finds happiness in the small joys of everyday life.

items.name: Agatha All Along
items.overview: Agatha Harkness gathers a coven of witches and sets off down, down, down The Witches' Road.

items.name: Ahsoka
items.overview: Former Jedi Knight Ahsoka Tano investigates an emerging threat to a vulnerable galaxy.

items.name: Black Summer
items.overview: In the dark, early days of a zombie apocalypse, complete strangers band together to find the strength they need to survive and get back to loved ones.

items.name: Criminal Justice A Family Matter
items.overview: Attorney Madhav Mishra represents Raj Nagpal, discovered with murdered nurse Roshni Saluja after his child's party. As the trial unfolds, hidden facts emerge, questioning identities.

items.name: Dhamaal with Pati Patni Aur Panga
Family Full House With Rohit Sharma
items.overview: Family Full House with Rohit Sharma features Indian cricketer Rohit Sharma making his television hosting debut on Sony TV. The family-focused game show brings competing families together for fun, survey-based trivia infused with Rohit's signature laid-back wit and humor.

items.name: Ghoul
items.overview: A newly minted military interrogator arrives at a covert detention center to discover that some of the terrorists held there are not of this world.

items.name: Good Doctor
items.overview: A man, who is an autistic savant, aspires to become a paediatrician. He overcomes societal discrimination and uses his exceptional abilities to achieve his dreams.

items.name: Love in Disguise
items.overview: Taekang Group's successor, Yoon Yi-jun, is the prime suspect of a shocking murder. To uncover the truth, Kang Jae-hee goes undercover as a male secretary to keep an eye on Yi-jun. The closer they get to what really happened, the closer Yi-jun and Jae-hee become. Will Jae-hee, who is hiding her identity, and Yi-jun, who is hiding a secret, be able to let their true feelings be known to one another?

items.name: Lucifer
items.overview: Bored and unhappy as the Lord of Hell, Lucifer Morningstar abandoned his throne and retired to Los Angeles, where he has teamed up with LAPD detective Chloe Decker to take down criminals. But the longer he's away from the underworld, the greater the threat that the worst of humanity could escape.

items.name: Suits LA
items.overview: Ted Black, a former federal prosecutor from New York, has reinvented himself representing the most powerful clients in Los Angeles. But his firm is at a crisis point, and in order to survive, he must embrace a role he held in contempt his entire career.

items.name: The Ordinary Jackpot
items.overview: An ordinary office worker wins the lottery – the amount isn't enough for him to quit his job, but it's enough to give him a new outlook on life.

items.name: The Stoneman Murders
items.overview: Find out if the Stoneman of 90's Kolkata still out in the streets? It's a thriller about the stone-man murders taking place in late 80s around Calcutta. hoichoi brings the story from a different point of view, showcasing why someone would resort to mass killing.

items.name: The Veil
items.overview: Two women play a deadly game of truth and lies on the road from Istanbul to Paris and London. One woman has a secret, the other a mission to reveal it before thousands of lives are lost. In the shadows, mission controllers at the CIA and French DGSE must put differences aside and work together to avert potential disaster.

items.name: What If
items.overview: Lok Chak-shun, a man who lives three different destinies shaped by his choices. Born prematurely in 1960s Hong Kong, he grows up passionate about comics. A school prank leads him to a fateful encounter with a mysterious girl, but a broken kite triggers a ripple in time, splitting his life into three divergent paths.
